name: lexfix-root
description: Root script to run all Lexfix services

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix adhd_learning_lexfix/backend" "npm run dev --prefix adhd_learning_lexfix/frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix adhd_learning_lexfix/backend && npm install --prefix adhd_learning_lexfix/frontend
